The company is shifting its focus to advanced manufacturing through its wholly owned subsidiary, Tiderock Composites, which serves rail, aerospace, and marine customers from the U.K.
The company plans to expand its manufacturing capabilities into the U.S. through engineering, production, and distribution partnerships.
It is also winding down non-core subsidiaries Vivara Global and Arcata Global as part of the strategic shift.
Existing shares remain valid, and stockholders do not need to take action.
